finalText:
Common cause: props look same but ain't same reference.

Big culprits:
- Inline object/array/function prop each render (`{}`, `[]`, `() => {}`) — new reference every time, even if content match.
- Parent re-render pass new function via arrow fn defined inline instead of `useCallback`.
- Context value change trigger all consumers, regardless of props.
- No `React.memo` wrap on child — default: child ALWAYS re-render when parent re-render, props irrelevant.

Fix:
- Wrap child in `React.memo(Child)` — shallow compare props, skip render if same.
- Wrap object/array props in `useMemo`.
- Wrap function props in `useCallback`.
